triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `area:ux` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p2` · Feature · `pm:queue` (routed to seat 1 per the maintainer's 05:20Z order on seat 2's unstarted work).
Rationale: this delivers the maintainer's ruling A′ on #36627. The Activity stream tab follows the object's capability switches, like Attachments follows `enable.files`, so when all three of its sources are off it is not drawn. Today such an object shows an empty 动态 tab on every record page. That is visible clutter on a common page, but no wrong data and no error, so p2 (UX has no p3). Seat grade p2 kept. This also settles the open question on #36542 (closed not planned).
